<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex2701_2024-09-1114-33-12" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">

            <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4659"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711"><expan>shes rab</expan> kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon par <expan>rtogs</expan> pa'i rgyan 'grel pa</rs> bcas pa'i rnaM bshad laM gyi rim pa snang ba</rs> zhes bya ba 'di <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5960"><expan>thams cad</expan> mkhyen pa 2 pa <expan>grags</expan> pa <expan>rgya mtsho</expan></rs>'i<anchor xml:id="a2"/><note type="editorial">Tentatively identified as Grags pa rgya mtsho (ID:5960). There's also Grags pa rgya mtsho bde legs 'byung gnas (ID:4024)</note> <lb n="90a5"/> zhabs <choice><sic>gdul</sic><corr>rdul</corr></choice> spyi bos len cing lung <expan>rigs</expan> kyi chos la <expan>blo gros</expan> cung zhig rgyas pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3927">ldum bu ba <choice><sic>bsoMd</sic><corr>bsod</corr></choice> naMs dpal</rs> gyis <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5658">'tshal gung thang <expan>gi gtsug</expan> lag khang chen po</rs>r <anchor xml:id="a3"/> sbyar ba ni re shig rdzogs s+ho ||</seg></TEI>
